extracted_songs.song_name: Slowly, Slowly, Very Slowly Goes the Garden Snail
extracted_songs.lyrics:
Slowly, slowly, very slowly goes the garden snail.
Slowly, slowly, very slowly up the garden rail.
Quickly, quickly, very quickly goes the little mouse.
Quickly, quickly, very quickly in his little house.

The moon is round
As round can be.
Two eyes, a nose, and a mouth,
Like me!

Pace goes the lady, the lady, the lady

Canter goes the gentleman, the gentleman, the gentleman
Canter goes the gentleman, the gentleman-Whoa!
Gallop goes the huntsman, the huntsman, the huntsman

And tumble in the ditch!

Jelly in the bowl,
Jelly in the bowl.
Wibble, wobble,
Wibble, wobble.
Jelly in the bowl.

Round and round the garden,
Like a teddy bear;

Tickle you under there.

extracted_songs.song_name: This Little Piggy Went to Market
extracted_songs.lyrics:
This little piggy went to market,
This little piggy stayed home,
This little piggy had roast beef,

This little piggy went wee, wee, wee all the way home.

Patty cake, patty cake, baker’s man,

Roll it, and pat it, and mark it with a “B”,
Put it in the oven for baby and me.

Put your shoes on, Lucy,
Don’t you know you’re in the city?

It really is a pity;
That Lucy can’t go barefoot,
Wherever she goes
‘Cause she likes to feel the wiggle of her toes!

These are baby’s fingers
These are baby’s toes

Here I am! (Bring other fist from behind and lift thumb)

Run and play…(Wiggling thumb, put the other fist behind back)

extracted_songs.song_name: The Grand Old Duke of York
extracted_songs.lyrics:
The grand old Duke of York,
He had ten thousand men.
He marched them up to the top of the hill
And he marched them down again.
When they were up they were up.
When they were down they were down.
When they were only half way up
They were neither up nor down.
He marched them to the left.
He marched them to the right.
He marched them around and around and around
And he marched them out of sight.

One Little, two little, three little Snowmen
Four little, five little, six little Snowmen
Seven little, eight little, nine little Snowmen
10 little Snowmen on the ground.

Dance like snowflakes
Dance like snowflakes
In the air
In the air
Whirling, twirling, snowflakes
Whirling, twirling snowflakes
Dancing everywhere.

Hush little baby, don’t say a word,
Mama’s gonna buy you a mockingbird.
And if that mockingbird don’t sing,
Mama’s gonna buy you a diamond ring.
And if that diamond ring turn brass,
Mama’s gonna buy you a looking glass.
And if that looking glass gets broke,
Mama’s gonna buy you a Billy goat.
And if that Billy goat don’t pull,
Mama’s gonna buy you a cart and bull.
And if that cart and bull turn over,
Mama’s gonna buy you a dog named Rover.
And if that dog named Rover won’t bark.
Mama’s gonna to buy you a horse and cart.
And if that horse and cart fall down,
You’ll still be the sweetest little baby in town.

extracted_songs.song_name: Rock Me Easy, Rock Me Slow
extracted_songs.lyrics:
Rock me easy, rock me slow,
Rock me where the robins go.
Rock the branch and rock the bough,
Rock the baby robins now.
Rock me up and rock me down,
Rock me off to sleepy town.
Rock me gently up the stairs
To cuddle with my teddy bears.
Rock me easy, rock me slow,
Rock me where the robins go.

notes: None of the 42 candidate songs (mostly Kathy Reid-Naiman baby songs and related library/agency rhymes, e.g. Bye Baby Bye, Baby Bear Waltz, Baby's Boat, Sweetest Little Baby, Rockin' my Baby, Mice Rhymes, Boom Boom Baby, etc.) appear in this PDF. This is a Perth Union Library 'Baby Songs & Rhymes Program' storytime handout containing standard nursery rhymes and action songs. Per brief rule 3, all 37 songs actually present in the PDF were captured with db_id: null because no master missing_lyrics_songs.json file exists in the workspace to resolve their db_ids. Text extracted cleanly via PyMuPDF (13 pages); no OCR needed. Verbatim transcription preserved, including original spelling/typos such as 'their so still', 'Mama's gonna to buy', and 'turn brass'.
